digest.component_or_area: Rebar reconciler and tickets repository storage
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% consumed by uncommitted .bridge_state cache bookkeeping fields (baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass) that are never read in src/, defeating git delta compression.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp and moving last_get_pass to a separate file reduces marginal packed cost per bindings.json version from 12.79 KB to ~1.74 KB (7.4x improvement) and halves version count growth.
The reconciler must keep .bridge_state committed because it runs on ephemeral GitHub runners, so durable state must live in git rather than being re-homed off-branch.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the existing tickets branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4% final size) while preserving all 49,888 commits, 2,661 merges, and making HEAD tree byte-identical to pre-rewrite tip.

The rollout requires descendant workflow execution, explicit host refresh, mixed-version self-healing, epoch guards at sync._union_merge and push.py, off-repo backup bundle verification, and quiesced writer coordination before reclaim execution.
